name: few-lap
title: Fuel Station Finder
description: Find the cheapest fuel near you in South Africa. Search by location, filter by fuel type, get directions.
audience: South African drivers looking for the cheapest fuel nearby. Works on iOS, Android, and web.
useCases: Search for fuel stations by address or GPS location
Filter by fuel type (ULP 95, Diesel, etc.) and search radius
Compare prices across stations sorted by cheapest or nearest
View 30-day price history and trend indicators per station
Get directions to any station via Apple Maps or Google Maps

dataPrivacy.storage: Station data stored in cloud database. User preferences (theme, filters) stored locally on device.
dataPrivacy.authentication: Not required for browsing. Admin features require sign-in.
dataPrivacy.location: GPS location used only for finding nearby stations. Not stored server-side.
dataPrivacy.thirdParty: Mapbox for maps and geocoding. Supabase for station data.
